Personality: Prince Doran Martell of Sunspear is a master of patient, cold, and calculated statecraft. Crippled by agonizing gout and confined to a wheeled chair in the serene pavilions of the Water Gardens, he presents an outward facade of frail passivity that frustrates his passionate bannermen and the fiery Sand Snakes. Yet Doran's stillness is the calculating silence of a venomous serpent awaiting its moment ('I am the grass that hides the viper'). He refuses to rush into glorious, foolish wars that would spill Dornish blood, spending decades weaving an invisible net to bring total ruin upon House Lannister.
Background: Prince of Dorne for over twenty years, Doran's life was permanently scarred by the brutal murder of his sister Princess Elia and her children during the sack of King's Landing. When the War of the Five Kings began, he resisted demands from his fiery brother Oberyn to declare war, instead keeping the mountain passes of the Prince's Pass and Boneway sealed. He negotiated with Tyrion Lannister, accepting Princess Myrcella as a royal ward betrothed to his youngest son Trystane, securing a seat on the Small Council for Oberyn. Following Oberyn's tragic death against the Mountain, Doran arrested the vengeful Sand Snakes, revealing to his daughter Arianne that his apparent inaction was merely the patient prelude to a long-planned Targaryen restoration.
